verbetes.glosa_atual: Elias; nome do profeta bíblico que aparece em relatos rabínicos como defensor dos justos.
definicoes_originais: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Eliyahu, Elijah, the great prophet in the days of Ahab, freq. represented, in Talmud and Midrashim, as intervening in behalf of the pious and punishing wrong-doers, and expected, in the Messianic days, to clear up doubts and prepare the heavenly kingdom; cmp. Mal. III, 23.
notas_originais: —Ber. 58 a, a. fr. אתא א' אידמי ליה וכ' E. came and appeared to him in the disguise of &c. Gen. R. s. 33, a. fr. אתא א' זכור לטוב E., whose memory be blessed, came &c. B. Mets. I, 8 (37 a), a. fr. יהא מונח עד שיבוא א' let it be deposited until E. shall come (and decide to whom it belongs, i.e. an indefinite time until the matter be cleared up). Men. 45 a; a. fr.—סֵדֶר אֵלִיָהוּ־ Seder Eliyahu, name of a lost Talmudic treatise, divided into Seder Eliyahu Rabba (Large) and S. E. Zuta (Small). Keth. 106 a (of legendary origin).

verbetes.glosa_atual: figueira de certa variedade; também lenha de figueira usada no altar.
definicoes_originais: wood of the fig-tree, used as kindling wood on the altar (h. form אֲלִיתָה).
notas_originais: —בְּרַת א' name of a fig species. Gen. R. s. 15, end ברת א' וכ' Ar. (ed. אלי) it is called brath alitha (daughter of mourning, v. אַלְיָתָא), because it has brought wailing and weeping into the world (as the fruit of the tree of knowledge).
Tam. II, 4 (Mish. תא …, Talm. 29 a … תה). Yoma 24 b. Y. ib. II, 39 c top.— Pl. אַלִּיתֹות. Par. III, 9.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Illitha; objeto ou substância supostamente capaz de evitar ou extinguir o fogo; sentido incerto.
definicoes_originais: (pronunc. and meaning doubtful) Illitha, something supposed to render fire-proof or extinguish the fire.
notas_originais: Snh. 108 b יש לנו דבר אחד וא' שמה Ar. (ed. וע') we have something, its name is Ill. [perhaps to be read דבר אחר a (female) idol]; Yalk. Job 906 עיל', Ms. עליונה]. [B. Bath. 73 a ומחינן ליה באלי' Ar. Var. s. v. אלתא, ed. אַלּוּתָא, Rashi אַלְוָותָא, Ms. Oxf. ואית לן, אלוותא pl. of אַלָּתָא. The use of the masc. gend. in connection with the word, makes the passage appear spurious.]
= אִילֵּין. Dan. III, 12; 13.
Y. Keth. V, beg. 29 c R. Al.—Ib. IX, 33 b א' אמר לו ר' מנא (read לר' מנא); Y. Shebu. VII, 38 a bot. ליכסה וכ' name of a gentile judge.

verbetes.glosa_atual: em diagonal; transversalmente; linha oblíqua ou diâmetro.
definicoes_originais: אֲלַכְסֹון, ch. form אֲלַכְסֹונָא m. diagonal line, diameter.
notas_originais: ἀλλάξ)
Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VIII, 5 two feet &c. of a bed cut off א' crosswise; (Kel. XVIII, 5 לוכסן).

B. Bath. 101 b; Succ. 8 a כל אמתא … באלכסונָהּ a figure of one square cubit has a diagonal line of 1 2/ 5 cubits (approximately). Men. 35 a; Meg. 24 b must be square בתפרן ובאֲלַכְסֹונָן both as to their seams (not warped) and as to the measure of their diagonal lines. Erub. 59 a מידת העיר ואלכסונָהּ Ms. K. (ed. בא', v. Rashi a. l.) the measure of the circumference of the town plus its diameter. B. Bath. 99 a ודילמא בא' הוו קיימי perhaps the Cherubim in the Sanctuary were placed across the room; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: espécie de noz chamada alexandrina, possivelmente pistache.
definicoes_originais: (v. אֲלַכְסָא) Alexandrians, name of a nut, prob. a species of pistachio.
notas_originais: Ab. Zar. 14 a אלכסין ed. (Ms. M. אלכסנדרין, Ar. אכלסין). Cmp. אִלְסָרִין.
Y. Dem. II, 22 c top, (an Amora of a place called Tsadoka). Cant. R. to IV, 12; v. אֲלֶכְסַנְדְּרִי.
A. the Great, מוקדון the Macedonian. Targ. Cant. VI, 8; Targ. II, Esth. I, 2.—Tam. 31 b; a. fr.
name of a judge and of a robber. Y. Ber. IX, 13 b top (for אלכסנדריאה ib. read our w.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: alexandrino; natural de Alexandria; também nome próprio de um amora.
definicoes_originais: pr. n. m. Alexandri, an Amora.
notas_originais: Sifra B’ḥukk. chap. V, Lulianus the Alex.
Y. R. Hash. IV, 59 c bot; a. e.—Cant. R. to IV, 2 דרא … (corr. acc.).

— Pl. אֲלֶכְסַנְדְּרִיִּים; fem. אֲלֶכְסַנְדְּרִיֹּות. Men. 100 a Alexandrians. Ib. 28 b כוסות א' (Yalk. Ex. 369 … רִיֹּות) Alexandrian cups (lengthy and narrow). Tosef. Meg. III (II), 6 בה"כ של א' a Synagogue built by Alexandrians in Jerusalem.
Targ. Ez. XXX, 15; a. e.—Y. Ḥag. II, 77 d; a. fr.—Kel. XV, 1, v. next w.—Midr. Till. to Ps. XIX, a ship coming מא'. V. אַכְסַנְדַּרְיָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: alexandrino; natural ou relativo a Alexandria.
notas_originais: Kel. XV, 1 ספינה א' Mish. ed. (Talm. ed. ס' אלכסנדריא) Alexandrian ship, i.e. Sea ship with water reservoirs. Sabb. 90 a, a. e. נתר א' Alex. nitron. Tosef. Nid. IV, 17 Cleopatra מלכת א' (ed. Zuck. יס—) Egyptian queen.— Pl. אֲלֶכְסַנְדְּרִיֹּות, v. אֲלֶכְסַנְדְּרִי.

verbetes.glosa_atual: circundar; andar à volta; espreitar; rastrear; procurar; também apontar ou ligar em acepções etimológicas propostas.
definicoes_originais: (sec. r. of אוּל, v. אֲוַל; cmp. עלל)
to tie around; to be strong; v. אֵל, אלי I, אֵלָה, אִילָּן &c., a. אלם.
notas_originais: Pi. אִילֵּל to go around; to espy, track. Cant. R. beg. (play on תּוּר a. תֹּורָה) אחר ד"ת אִילַּלְתָּ thou didst search after the words of the Law. Pesik. R. s. 47 ḥ afar (Job XXXIX, 29) לשון מְאַלֵּל has the meaning of espying (ed. incorr. יליל, v. ed. Friedm. p. 190 b).—[

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma aramaica intensiva de אָלַל; circundar, observar ou espreitar.
notas_originais: Targ. Num. XIII, 2; a. fr.—Deriv. אַלִּילָא, מְאַלְּלָא.
